releases.summary: Replaces stale constellation metadata with one bounded clean-slate root-discovery release and one current TinyRustLM source-authority rule.
changes: Bound every current ecosystem lane to its independently read-back public release identity and removed an unresolvable proposed lane from current claims.
Removed superseded duplicate AI-ready metadata contracts from current source and public routing; their bytes remain only in Git and immutable deployment evidence.
Retired the publicly readable private workspace handoff and obsolete root-discovery ZIP packages from the web root.

Added fail-closed tests and create-only deployment controls that reject duplicate source authority, stale-tree union merges, unregistered files, remote before-state drift, or nonterminal publication evidence.
limitations: This release does not replace or certify the WordPress application source.
This release proves no qualified model, model inference, peer availability, portable-memory round, or campaign progress.
